messages:
maya: Opening intake for model weights we pulled: https://hugging.example.org/cobalt-7b-v1 (sha256: abc123...)
maya: License header shows 'NonCommercial-Restricted v1.0' — need legal on whether we can host, serve via API, or redistribute.
igor: can you paste the exact license snippet here?
sasha-legal: pasted snippet from model repo: \"NonCommercial-Restricted v1.0 — No commercial use, no redistribution, attribution required.\" That suggests we cannot offer it via our hosted API or distribute weights to customers without explicit permission.
maya: noted. also planning quantization experiments (int8 / 4-bit) — will run quality regressions vs float baseline. setting up eval plan.
arjun: quick Q: is this customer-driven or research? helps decide gate priority.
maya: research-first, but might be used for internal demos. no paying-customer requests yet.
tess: security question: any flagged pretraining data in model card? link?
maya: model card: https://hugging.example.org/cobalt-7b-v1/card — mentions web-scraped forums and some user posts. potential PII leakage; need privacy triage before any hosting.
sasha-legal: short answer from legal standpoint: no hosted offering or redistribution until vendor grants commercial/server rights. Private deployments may be possible if customer holds their own license and we don't redistribute weights, but we need explicit vendor permission for that too. Also check export control/geo restrictions.
igor: infra notes — even for Private we need to know: can we cache the weights for faster cold starts? do we need to treat them as restricted artifacts? also quantify memory/disk for quantized variants.
sasha-legal: export clause present: \"No distribution to embargoed countries\" — we'll need to enforce geo-restrictions and add a gating checklist item. legal will draft wording.
maya: suggested next steps (short):
- legal: confirm commercial/redistribution rights + geo/export constraints
- security: PII sampling + privacy risk triage
- infra: run quantization smoke tests + baseline perf
- product: classify priority (research vs customer-ready)
igor: I'll spin up a small smoke run (10 samples) for int8/4bit, measure latency/throughput and SQuAD/MMLU delta. need exact weights path/commit.
maya: weights link and sha256 already above.
arjun: product marks as \"research-only\" for now. no customer rollout without legal thumbs up :thumbsup:
sasha-legal: I'll prepare a one-pager gating doc and ask vendor contact for commercial license and redistribution permission. target: EOD Wed for initial response.
maya: thanks — pinging @sasha-legal and @tess to keep followups here.
deploy-bot: scheduled job cobalt-7b-v1/quant-smoke started at 2312349920
igor: smoke run finished: int8 perf OK, but quality drop ~3% on SQuAD vs float baseline. logs excerpt: ```latency: 62ms\nthroughput: 27 req/s\nsquad-f1: 87.2 -> 84.2```
maya: noted. we'll add a minimum quality threshold (+2% delta tolerated) to the bring-up checklist and rerun with calibration prompts.
